using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Garnet.server;
using System;
using System.Text;

namespace Garnet.Tests
{
    public class VectorManagerTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogError_Called_When_Exception_Occurs()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var vectorManager = new Mock<VectorManager>(1, new GarnetServerOptions(), () => new Mock<IMessageConsumer>().Object, new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object);
            vectorManager.CallBase = true;
            vectorManager.Setup(vm => vm.logger).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            var toDeleteKey = new SpanByte(new byte[] { 1, 2, 3 });
            var toDeleteCtx = 1;

            // Act
            vectorManager.Object.ResumePostRecovery();

            // Assert
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.LogError(
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
